provenance.method: Northern Ireland insomnia route from nidirect, preserving HSC/NI separation from GB.

question: My sleep problems are persistent and I live in Northern Ireland. Where can I start?
why_it_matters: Northern Ireland has a distinct health system and should not inherit GB service assumptions.
current_understanding: nidirect provides public insomnia information and advises appropriate clinical help. ND Oracle does not infer a diagnosis, medication need or a uniform specialist pathway from that information.
evidence_needed: Trust-level sleep-service routes where stable and useful to real user journeys.
reopening_conditions: nidirect or HSC sleep-service guidance changes materially.
dissent: Trust-level detail can improve navigation but can become stale quickly and therefore needs shorter review cadence.
